entries.title: A crewmate on another Mac keeps its pace while that Mac is busy
entries.body: A crewmate working on another Mac now runs its builds and tests at that Mac's normal priority. Before, they ran below everything else there, so on a busy Mac they ran slowly and their tests could fail with nothing wrong in your project. A Mac you added by its address picks this up at its next update in Settings → Devices. Any other Mac picks it up once you add it again, whether you added it with a command or by pasting its link when it first opened.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: a crewmate on another Mac finishes its builds and tests sooner, and its tests stop failing while that Mac is busy.
